unknown.notExist: This policy type does not exist

dialog.deleteDescription: Rule "{{name}}" will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

rewrite.description: Modify request body fields with a JSON operation array
rewrite.empty: No request rewrite rules yet. Click "Add rule" to create the first one

failover.description: Fail over to the next candidate along a dimension when a request fails or a condition matches
failover.empty: No failover rules yet. Click "Add rule" to create the first one

form.dimensionHint: Matches are counted first; only once the hit threshold is reached does the request fail over along this dimension to the next candidate.
form.autoDisableYesHint: Skip and disable: once the same target reaches the hit threshold within the window, move to the next candidate and then disable it.
form.autoDisableNoHint: Skip only: once the same target reaches the hit threshold within the window, only move to the next candidate without disabling it.
form.patternsLabel: Count one hit when the upstream error contains these keywords
form.patternsPlaceholder:
One keyword or error code per line
429
rate_limit_exceeded
insufficient_quota
form.patternsHint: One per line; any line appearing in the upstream error counts as one hit. Leave empty to use only the conditions below.
form.speedHint: 0 means no limit. Greater than 0 means a request-wide speed (total tokens ÷ total time including connection) below N token/s also counts as one hit (OR with keywords); the action above runs once the hit threshold is reached.
form.ttfbHint: 0 disables this condition. Greater than 0 means a first byte slower than N seconds also counts as one hit (OR with keywords).
form.thresholdHint: Once the same target hits N times within the window, the action above runs. Window 0 means no time limit; 1 means run on the first hit.

response.description: Apply to response fields in order: rename / prefix / suffix / delete
response.empty: No response rewrite rules yet. Click "Add rule" to create the first one
